report.title: High Value Party Balances
report.query: SELECT name AS CustomerName, phone_number AS Phone, type AS Type, (net_balance_in_cents / 100.0) AS BalanceInRupees FROM parties WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND ABS(net_balance_in_cents) >= 1000000 ORDER BY ABS(net_balance_in_cents) DESC;

report.title: Inventory Stock Valuation by Unit
report.description: Warehouse SKU stock counts and valuation in integer cents
report.query: SELECT sku AS SKU, name AS ItemName, unit AS Unit, current_stock_quantity AS Quantity, (purchase_price_in_cents / 100.0) AS CostPrice, ((purchase_price_in_cents * current_stock_quantity) / 100.0) AS TotalValuation FROM inventory_items WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY TotalValuation DESC;
